resolution.plan: Long-document handling is resolved by Sec. 4.2: GPT-4 Turbo's 128K context is used to feed whole judgments, and the target length rule K x |Exp|/|Doc| reduces to the reference summary length for a single chunk. For each of the 100 UK-Abs test judgments prompt gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09 with '<full judgment> Summarize the document in <YY> words' with YY = reference summary word count, and compute ROUGE-L F1 vs Table 4 (0.198).
